newsitem.title: CHINA: Praxair to help China build semiconductors.
newsitem.headline: Praxair to help China build semiconductors.

text.p: Praxair Inc on Tuesday signed a $10 million contract with China's Hua Hong Microelectronics Co Ltd to provide high purity gasses for the production of semiconductors, the firms announced at a news conference.

Hua Hong is a state-owned company set up in Shanghai last year with top-level support from Beijing to lead a $1.2 billion project to push forward China's integrated circuit (IC) production capability.
Shanghai Praxair Yidian Inc has been set up as a 50-50 joint venture between Praxair and Shanghai Maike Electronics, to provide purified nitrogen and oxygen to Hua Hong, a Praxair official said.

Praxair Yidian will construct a gas generation plant at the site of Hua Hong's IC factory, being built in the Pudong development zone east of Shanghai's city centre, where production is expected to begin in mid-1998.
Hua Hong is leading a venture known as "Project 909", approved by China's State Council (cabinet) to produce IC wafers with a thickness of 0.5 microns.
Officials say it is the single biggest investment China has yet made in the electronics industry.
